maddeler.e:
أتبختر (form IIq)
# أَتَبَخْتَرُ (ʔatabaḵtaru) /ʔa.ta.bax.ta.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
# أَتَبَخْتَرَ (ʔatabaḵtara) /ʔa.ta.bax.ta.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
# أَتَبَخْتَرْ (ʔatabaḵtar) /ʔa.ta.bax.tar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَبَخْتَرَ (tabaḵtara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
